title: Libby Treasure Girl
author: Tomer Yakoby
review_notes: Bedtime picture book about love, hugs, smiles and kisses between a little girl and her parent; family is the most important thing to Libby. Illustrated by Marcin Piwowarski, 36 pages, hardcover, for young children. I wrote it after October 7 as part of a volunteer project to promote the Jewish value of love. Do not mention the dedication or any names from it.
